answer.justification: High-dose acetaminophen and aspirin use is a classic cause of analgesic nephropathy leading to papillary necrosis. The presentation of acute colicky flank pain, gross hematuria, and proteinuria fits papillary necrosis (sloughed papillae can cause colic). Diffuse cortical necrosis is typically ischemic/obstetric; chronic pyelonephritis requires recurrent infections; acute nephrolithiasis is less specific given the clear analgesic abuse history.
